name: ivision launcher
summary:
Create your own 2D shortcut menu with ivision launcher. Choose launchable apps already installed on your device and keep their icons in a personal menu.

• Browse circular icons across horizontal pages.
• Hold an icon to reorder or remove it.
• Open an app and let the menu close its own panel.
• Follow the system theme or choose light or dark.
• Adjust icon size and page density.
• Enable quick reopen to reuse recent local icon caches.
• Keep selections on your device and clear them from the privacy page.
